recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有多團無色、透明的長方形或菱形針柱狀結晶呈放射狀（玫瑰花狀）排列，周圍圍繞多核異物巨細胞與纖維化基質，這種放射狀排列的透明結晶是草酸鈣沉積（oxalosis）的特徵。
features: Clusters of colorless, refractile, rhomboid to rod-shaped crystals arranged in radiating rosettes
Crystal aggregates surrounded by multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Fibrotic spindle-cell stroma replacing normal hematopoietic marrow
Scattered brown pigment granules (likely hemosiderin) at lower left
No residual hematopoietic cells in this field
describe_en: High-power H&E section of bone marrow trephine shows replacement of the marrow space by fibrotic spindle-cell stroma containing multiple aggregates of colorless, refractile, rhomboid and rod-shaped crystals arranged in radiating rosettes. The crystal deposits are rimmed by multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells, and scattered brown pigment is present. Normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. The crystal morphology, with confirmation of birefringence under polarized light, is consistent with calcium oxalate deposition (oxalosis), typically primary hyperoxaluria or end-stage renal disease.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are needle-shaped, strongly negatively birefringent and usually dissolve in aqueous formalin, leaving amorphous tophaceous material with palisading histiocytes.
CPPD crystals are short rhomboid, weakly positively birefringent, and typically involve cartilage and joints rather than diffusely replacing marrow.
Metastatic carcinoma shows cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests in fibrotic marrow, without crystal rosettes.
PMF shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis without crystalline deposits or foreign-body giant cells.
